source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 Hardware required: RDIMM with ECC / HDT Software tool: AMD RAS Error Injection Tool 1. BIOS settings: a. CPU Common Options → Platform First Error Handling: Enabled b. CPU Common Options → MCA error thresh enable: TRUE c. CPU Common Options → MCA error thresh count: FFE (Deviate from default setting FF5) d. FCH Common Options → FCH RAS Options → Reset After Sync-Flood: Enable 2. Unlock CPU via HDT. 3. Boot into Ubuntu 20.04/RHEL 9.0 / Windows 2022. 4. Download the AMD RAS Error Injection Tool, then install and open the software. 5. Enter the following commands: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --dferror --socket 0 --errortype 0 6. The system will reset immediately. 7. When system boot into operating system again, check dmesg log. 8. To ensure sync_flood was triggered correctly, use HDT to check that FCH::PM:: S5_RESET_STATUS[SyncFlood]=1 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: 1. For uncorrectable errors, verify that the errors are logged correctly in BERT dmesg after the warm reset is triggered. 2. If the OS reports the error within a timeout period, the test passed. 3. If the OS does not report the error within a timeout period, the test failed.

AMD tool/spec proof --dferror errortype0 selects IOM WDT and expected SyncFlood/reset path
MCA threshold FF5/FFE encoding, relevance and raw before/target/restore values
FCH::PM::S5_RESET_STATUS[SyncFlood] register definition, persistence, W1C/clear method and before/after freshness rule
Fresh BERT/CPER source/severity fields that distinguish IOM WDT from CCM and other SyncFlood causes
Supported OS/kernel, reset/firmware/boot and OS-report deadlines, aborts, OOB recovery and restoration
